title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Business Development Manager – Education & Institutional Printing**

**Location:** Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi

**Experience:** 2–4 years (relevant printing-industry experience preferred)

**Department:** Sales, Marketing & Business Development

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven sales and business development professional from the printing, commercial printing, publishing, or print-production industry who has experience building B2B business with schools, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions. The person must understand institutional printing requirements and be able to open doors, develop relationships with decision-makers, convert opportunities into orders, and grow repeat business.

This is a hands-on, revenue-focused role—not a general education-sector sales position. Candidates with a proven track record of selling printed products and print solutions to educational institutions, along with an active network of relevant buyers and influencers, will be strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, prospect, and acquire new school groups, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, training institutes, and other education-sector accounts across North India.
* Generate business for the full range of institutional printing needs, including certificates, diplomas, examination papers and answer booklets, question papers, textbooks, workbooks, academic books, prospectuses, admission kits, brochures, flyers, pamphlets, newsletters, magazines, journals, booklets, annual reports, diaries, notebooks, stationery, ID cards, event collateral, and customized print material.
* Build relationships with school owners/directors, principals, registrars, examination controllers, heads of administration, purchase and procurement teams, publishers, department heads, marketing teams, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Understand each institution’s annual academic calendar, examination schedule, admission cycle, events, print volumes, specifications, quality expectations, delivery timelines, and budget to identify upcoming and recurring requirements.
* Create and maintain a strong pipeline through field visits, referrals, industry networks, institutional databases, tenders, vendor registrations, and proactive outreach.
* Prepare quotations, cost estimates, proposals, presentations, samples, and commercial offers in coordination with internal teams; negotiate pricing and terms to close profitable business.
* Identify opportunities for annual contracts, rate agreements, empanelment, repeat orders, and multi-campus or group-level contracts to build predictable recurring revenue.
* Own the complete sales cycle—from lead generation and meetings through requirement gathering, proposal submission, negotiation, order confirmation, and relationship management after delivery.
* Coordinate with production, pre-press, design, procurement, quality, and dispatch teams to ensure print specifications, quality standards, delivery schedules, and client commitments are met.
* Maintain account plans, CRM records, sales forecasts, order status, collections follow-ups, and competitor intelligence; report pipeline, conversion, revenue, margins, and key-account progress regularly.
* Explore cross-selling and upselling opportunities across product categories and identify new institutions, geographies, and printing applications to expand business.
* Travel as required across Delhi NCR, Haryana, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, and other North Indian markets.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 2–4 years of experience in sales, marketing, institutional sales, or business development, preferably with a commercial printer, printing press, print-solutions provider, publishing/educational printing company, or related print-production business.
* Demonstrated success in generating revenue by selling printed products or printing services to schools, colleges, universities, publishers, or other institutional customers.
* Strong understanding of print products, paper and print specifications, quantities, finishing/binding options, quality expectations, production lead times, and cost drivers—or the ability to demonstrate substantial practical exposure to these areas.
* An existing network of education-sector clients and an ability to access relevant purchase, administration, examination, academic, and management stakeholders.
* Proven ability to open new accounts, manage a sales pipeline, negotiate commercials, close orders, and achieve revenue and profitability targets.
* Working knowledge of institutional procurement, tender participation, vendor empanelment, quotation comparisons, purchase orders, and payment/collection follow-up.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, planning, and relationship-building skills; comfortable with field sales and frequent client visits.
* Self-driven, target-oriented, and capable of working independently while coordinating closely with internal production and operations teams.

**Preferred Profile**

* Candidates currently working with commercial printing presses, offset/digital printing companies, educational book and stationery printers, publishers, or print-production/service providers.
* Candidates who have personally handled accounts for schools, colleges, universities, examination boards, coaching networks, or education groups.
* Candidates able to demonstrate a portfolio of institutional accounts, repeat business, major orders won, or annual/seasonal printing contracts.
* Experience in North India markets and familiarity with institutional buying cycles will be an advantage.
* Graduate in any discipline. An MBA/PGDM in Sales or Marketing is an advantage; relevant industry experience and demonstrated business-generation results will carry greater weight.
* Excellent communication skills

Pay: Up to ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Business development: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Okhla, Delhi, Delhi (Preferred)

Job Description: Business Development Manager (BDM)

**Company:** TBW Global Sourcing House Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, New Delhi  
**Department:** Business Development Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 2–5 years preferred

**About the Company**

TBW Global Sourcing House, part of the TWI Group of Companies, specialises in industrial product sourcing and strategic project supply, helping businesses meet their industrial procurement and supply requirements.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a result-orientated business development manager to identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with industrial clients, understand their sourcing requirements, and generate revenue through product sourcing and project supply solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities with manufacturers, industrial companies, contractors, project developers, and corporate procurement teams.
* Generate leads through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, and industry research.
* Identify potential clients requiring industrial products, equipment, materials, and project-related supplies.
* Understand client procurement requirements, product specifications, quantities, budgets, and delivery expectations.
* Coordinate with sourcing and procurement teams to identify suitable products, suppliers, and commercial solutions.
* Develop and maintain relationships with buyers, procurement managers, suppliers, and business partners.
* Prepare business proposals, quotations, product presentations, and commercial offers based on client requirements.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial conditions to secure profitable business opportunities.
* Follow up on enquiries, quotations, and proposals to convert prospects into confirmed orders.
* Explore new industries, markets, and project opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Maintain a database of prospective clients, business opportunities, and ongoing negotiations.
* Track sales performance, prepare business development reports, and achieve assigned revenue targets.

**Required Skills**

* Strong B2B sales, lead generation, and client acquisition skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
* Understanding of industrial procurement, product sourcing, or project supply is preferred.
* Ability to understand client requirements and coordinate with internal sourcing teams.
* Strong market research, commercial awareness, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and CRM tools.
* A proactive, target-driven approach with the ability to develop business independently.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 2–5 years in business development, B2B sales, industrial procurement, or sourcing-related business.
* Candidates with experience handling industrial clients, corporate procurement, vendor networks, or project-based sales will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New client acquisition and qualified lead generation.
* Conversion of enquiries and proposals into confirmed orders.
* Revenue generation and achievement of assigned sales targets.
* Development of long-term client and business partner relationships.
* Expansion into new industrial markets and project supply opportunities.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment

Foxbrain is seeking an energetic, results-driven, and articulate **Sales Head** to lead our in-person sales and counselling operations.

This is a **purely high-value closing role** with **zero calling and zero lead generation responsibilities**. Leads are pre-qualified and brought to the center. Your primary mission is to conduct high-impact, face-to-face counselling sessions, build instant rapport with walk-in prospects, and drive immediate, on-the-spot conversions.

* **Skill Set:** Exceptional persuasion, negotiation, and emotional intelligence to read body language and close deals on the spot.
* **Work Ethic:** Target-oriented mindset with high energy and resilience.

* **Zero Calling Hassle:** No cold calling, no dialing, and no lead generation stress. Focus 100% on high-value counselling and closing.

title: Senior Manager – Specification & Architectural Sales (Pan-India)
description:
We are looking for a high-performing, technically sound **Specification & Architectural Business Development Lead** with proven hands-on experience in influencing architects, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) consultants, and design engineers. Your primary mission is to get our product range written into official project specifications (**Spec-In**) at the design stage for major commercial, industrial, hospitality, and residential development projects across India.

In this role, you will work early in the project lifecycle to build strong advisory relationships with key influencers, ensuring our brand is designated as the preferred/approved make in tender documents and BOQs (Bill of Quantities), directly enabling our field sales team to win project tenders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Consultants & Architects Management:** Establish and maintain high-level relationships with leading architects, MEP consultants, facade consultants, project management consultants (PMCs), and design heads.
* **Specification Drive (Spec-In):** Conduct technical presentations, product mock-ups, and CPD (Continuing Professional Development) sessions to get our product portfolio specified in project drawings, tender books, and vendor lists.
* **Early Project Pipeline Tracking:** Identify upcoming commercial, industrial, healthcare, hospitality, and mega-residential projects in the planning/concept stage across India.
* **Value Engineering & Customization:** Partner with architects and MEP consultants to solve technical challenges, offering compliant product configurations, sample approvals, and custom specifications to outmaneuver competitors.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Hand off locked-in project specifications and key consultant connections to regional field sales and execution teams to secure contract wins during the bidding phase.
* **Competitor & Market Intelligence:** Track competitor listings in consultant libraries, monitor changing industry codes/standards, and adjust positioning strategies to maintain market dominance.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 6–12+ years of hands-on experience in B2B technical specification, architectural sales, or prescription sales in industries like Building Materials, HVAC, Electrical, Lighting, Plumbing, Automation, MEP Systems, or Commercial Interiors.
* **Consultant Network:** Existing, strong personal network with top-tier Indian architecture firms, MEP consultancy practices, and PMCs.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Deep understanding of architectural blueprints, MEP design integration, BOQ structures, and tender documentation processes.
* **Influencing & Negotiation:** Superior presentation and consultative sales skills with the confidence to articulate technical value propositions to principal architects and senior engineers.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture (B.Arch), Civil Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred (MBA is a plus).

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Top-of-market base salary with lucrative commission structures tied to successful specification conversions and project wins.
* **Strategic Autonomy:** Opportunity to own national or key regional specification pipelines.
* **Career Growth:** Direct path to Head of Architectural Sales & Consultant Relations.

**Title: Executive – Service Sales**

**About Otis India**
--------------------

**Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator company, moving 2.5 billion people every day and maintaining over ~2.5 million units globally. With a global team of 72,000 colleagues, including 45,000 field professionals, Otis delivers innovative, safe and reliable mobility solutions found in many of the world’s most iconic buildings and busiest transport hubs. Operating in 200+ countries and territories, Otis combines global expertise with strong local capabilities. Guided by a clear vision to help people thrive in a taller, faster, smarter world, Otis is committed to customer‑centric service, future‑focused innovation, and responsible corporate citizenship.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The role is responsible for driving Service Sales performance through effective enquiry generation, persuasive negotiation, and timely AMC finalization. It ensures on‑time AMC renewals while maintaining strong customer engagement and relationship management. The position supports Service Operations by preparing proposals, agreements, and other contractual documentation with accuracy and compliance. It contributes to business growth by developing market intelligence, identifying new opportunities, and enhancing overall customer experience. The role requires close coordination with field teams service supervisors & Managers and customers during site visits, always ensuring full adherence to OTIS Ethics, Safety, Quality standards and protocols.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Drive enquiry generation, lead negotiations, and order finalization to achieve service sales targets.
* Ensure timely renewal of AMC contracts through proactive and continuous customer engagement.
* Coordinate closely with the Service Supervisor to strengthen customer communication and support prompt issue resolution.
* Improve conversions, enhance recoveries, and contribute to overall T‑business growth through structured, data‑driven actions.
* Develop comprehensive sales negotiation data sheets and high‑quality proposals tailored to customer requirements.
* Prepare and complete tender submissions, including technical clarifications, commercial details, and required legal documentation.
* Conduct customer meetings to understand requirements, address concerns, and strengthen business relationships.
* Maintain and regularly update Customer History Cards for key and strategic accounts.
* Collaborate with service and sales teams to enhance customer experience and ensure business continuity.
* Create compelling presentations for customers and internal stakeholders to support sales and service initiatives.
* Manage account receivables effectively to support healthy cash flow and timely collections.
* Adhere strictly to all safety protocols and procedures during site visits and customer interactions.
* Manage and maintain the Customer CRM for all AMC billings, ensuring accuracy, timely updates service reports along bills, and proper documentation.
Closely monitor customer complaints and lift performance, with a strong focus on parameters linked to KPI scores maintaining uptime of elevators, enabling improved service quality and customer satisfaction.  

**Qualification & Requirements**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Mechanical, or Electronics Engineering.
* 2+ years of experience in AMC sales and direct customer service, with a strong track record of customer engagement and retention.
* Proven negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and positively influence customer decisions.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Demonstrates a strong commitment to understanding and meeting customer needs, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.
* Effective Interpersonal Skills: Builds positive relationships through clear communication, active listening, and respect for diverse perspectives.
* Collaboration & Teamwork: Works seamlessly with cross-functional teams, fostering cooperation to achieve shared goals.
* Results-Driven Approach: Focuses on achieving targets and delivering outcomes with a sense of urgency and accountability.
* Adaptability & Proactive Attitude: Responds positively to change, anticipates challenges, and takes initiative to address issues before they escalate.

**What You Need to Be Successful at Otis**

  

* **Customer‑Centric Mindset**  
  Otis is committed to being a world‑class, customer‑focused service company, success begins with understanding and caring for customer needs.
* **Problem‑Solving & Technical Curiosity**  
  Innovation is core to Otis’ heritage—Being curious, analytical, and apply engineering principles.

* We encourage and support smart risk taking with ownership and accountability.

* **Collaboration & Communication**

* We work together as a one team we partner, create connections and contribute across Otis.

* **Future‑Focused Mindset**  
  Otis looks for individuals who are smart, adaptive, digitally aware, and excited to shape the future of smarter, safer mobility.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Sales Executive / Business Development Manager – Agro Commodities (B2B)

**Company:** Kasious Impex Private Limited  
**Location:** Delhi NCR, India  
**Industry:** Agro Commodities | Food Ingredients | Wholesale Trading | Import & Export  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–8+ Years (Relevant Industry Experience Required)  
**Travel:** Delhi NCR and Pan-India, as required  
**Compensation:** Competitive Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Sales Incentives

About the Company

Kasious Impex Private Limited is an established agro-commodity processing, trading, and import-export company specializing in cashew nuts, dry fruits, spices, nuts, and other agricultural commodities.

With an established presence in domestic and international markets, we serve wholesale distributors, food manufacturers, institutional buyers, traders, and businesses across multiple industries.

As part of our expansion across India, we are seeking a commercially driven and experienced sales professional based in Delhi NCR to strengthen our domestic sales network, develop high-value business relationships, and consistently generate profitable sales opportunities.

Position Overview

We are looking for a **high-performing B2B Sales Executive / Business Development Manager** with proven experience in the agro-commodity trading industry.

The ideal candidate must possess strong market knowledge, an established network of buyers, exceptional negotiation abilities, and a demonstrated track record of independently generating and closing high-value commodity sales.

This is a **revenue-generating, field-oriented sales position**, not merely a lead-generation or sales coordination role.

The selected candidate will be responsible for actively developing business, identifying high-volume buyers, negotiating commercially viable transactions, converting enquiries into confirmed orders, and expanding the company's presence in Delhi NCR and other strategic markets across India.

We are particularly interested in candidates capable of generating consistent daily business activity and building a sustainable pipeline of repeat, high-volume orders.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales Generation & Revenue Growth**

* Independently identify, approach, negotiate with, and convert prospective B2B buyers into active customers.
* Consistently generate new sales opportunities and secure confirmed purchase orders.
* Drive high-value and bulk-volume commodity sales while maintaining commercially acceptable profit margins.
* Develop recurring business from existing and newly acquired customers.
* Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly sales, volume, revenue, and collection targets.

**2. B2B Client Acquisition & Market Development**

* Build and maintain relationships with wholesalers, distributors, importers, food processors, manufacturers, institutional buyers, and bulk commodity traders.
* Target high-volume consumers such as confectionery manufacturers, biscuit and bakery industries, ice cream manufacturers, sweet manufacturers, food ingredient companies, and large wholesale distributors.
* Identify potential customers across Delhi NCR and other major commercial markets in India.
* Develop new regional sales channels and expand the company's customer base through direct field visits, referrals, and industry networking.

**3. Commodity Trading & Product Knowledge**

* Demonstrate practical knowledge of agro-commodity grades, specifications, market pricing, seasonal demand, quality parameters, and trading practices.
* Handle products including cashew kernels and pieces, dry fruits, nuts, spices, and other agricultural commodities.
* Understand bulk pricing, packaging requirements, quality expectations, delivery arrangements, and customer-specific requirements.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, price fluctuations, and emerging business opportunities.

**4. Negotiation & Deal Closure**

* Independently conduct commercial negotiations with buyers and procurement decision-makers.
* Negotiate pricing, order quantities, payment terms, delivery schedules, and repeat supply arrangements within company-approved limits.
* Convert qualified enquiries into profitable confirmed orders with minimal supervision.
* Protect company margins while maintaining long-term customer relationships.
* Coordinate with management for major contracts, exceptional pricing, and high-value transactions.

**5. Customer Relationship Management**

* Establish direct relationships with business owners, procurement managers, purchase heads, and key decision-makers.
* Maintain regular communication with customers to identify upcoming requirements and repeat-order opportunities.
* Ensure timely follow-up on quotations, samples, negotiations, purchase orders, and payments.
* Work closely with the operations and accounts teams to ensure smooth order execution and customer satisfaction.

**6. Field Sales & Pan-India Business Expansion**

* Conduct regular market visits, customer meetings, and business development activities across Delhi NCR.
* Travel to other Indian states when required for customer acquisition, market expansion, negotiations, and business development.
* Identify and develop promising wholesale markets, industrial clusters, and institutional accounts.
* Represent the company professionally during client meetings, trade events, and industry interactions.

**7. Sales Reporting & Accountability**

* Maintain accurate records of customer enquiries, quotations, negotiations, orders, and sales follow-ups.
* Submit daily activity reports covering customer meetings, leads generated, opportunities advanced, and orders secured.
* Prepare weekly sales forecasts and market intelligence reports.
* Maintain a structured pipeline of active prospects, expected orders, and repeat business opportunities.
* Coordinate with management to achieve revenue, profitability, and collection objectives.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, Agriculture, International Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of proven experience in **B2B agro-commodity sales, wholesale trading, food ingredient distribution, or agricultural commodity marketing**.
* Preference for candidates with 5+ years of direct experience selling bulk agro commodities.
* Demonstrated ability to acquire customers independently and close substantial commercial transactions.
* Existing relationships with wholesale buyers, food manufacturers, distributors, and procurement professionals will be a significant advantage.
* Strong understanding of Delhi NCR's commodity trading markets and distribution networks.
* Willingness to undertake frequent business travel across India.

Essential Skills & Competencies

**Strongly Required**

* **Proven B2B Sales Closing Ability:** Demonstrated success in converting prospects into confirmed, revenue-generating orders.
* **Advanced Negotiation Skills:** Ability to negotiate high-value commodity transactions while protecting margins.
* **Existing Industry Network:** Established relationships with genuine bulk buyers, distributors, wholesalers, or institutional procurement teams.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong understanding of commodity pricing, profit margins, credit exposure, payment terms, and market competition.
* **Independent Business Development:** Ability to prospect, generate leads, arrange meetings, negotiate, and close deals without constant supervision.
* **Relationship Management:** Ability to develop long-term, repeat-purchase relationships with commercial buyers.
* **Results Orientation:** Strong ownership of sales targets, follow-ups, customer acquisition, and business growth.
* **Market Intelligence:** Ability to identify demand patterns, buyer requirements, competitor pricing, and new trading opportunities.

**Additional Skills**

* Strong verbal communication in Hindi and English.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, WhatsApp Business, and basic CRM or sales reporting systems.
* Good understanding of GST invoicing, trade documentation, logistics coordination, and B2B payment practices.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with the company's management and operations teams.

Travel & Company Support

This position is based in Delhi NCR, with business travel across India as required.

For authorized official business trips, the company will provide:

* Company-sponsored travel expenses in accordance with company policy.
* Food and meal expenses during approved official business trips.
* Accommodation expenses for approved outstation business travel, where applicable.
* Necessary operational support for customer visits, business meetings, and market development activities.

Performance Expectations

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Maintain consistent daily customer outreach, follow-ups, and sales development activity.
* Regularly acquire new high-potential B2B buyers.
* Generate a continuous pipeline of genuine bulk purchase requirements.
* Convert opportunities into confirmed, profitable sales orders.
* Build recurring monthly business through long-term customer relationships.
* Expand the company's sales footprint beyond Delhi NCR into other commercially significant markets.
* Achieve agreed sales and collection targets while maintaining ethical trading practices and company-approved commercial terms.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in professionals currently working or previously employed in:

* Established agro-commodity trading companies.
* Cashew, dry fruit, and spice wholesale distribution businesses.
* Food ingredient suppliers and manufacturers.
* Commodity brokerage and bulk agricultural trading firms.
* Institutional food supply and FMCG raw-material distribution companies.

**Candidates with an active network of bulk commodity buyers and a verifiable record of high-value B2B sales will be given preference.**

Why Join Kasious Impex?

* Opportunity to work with an established agro-commodity processing and international trading business.
* Exposure to a broad portfolio of agricultural commodities and institutional customers.
* Significant scope to develop new markets and build a strong sales network across India.
* Direct involvement in high-value commercial negotiations and business expansion.
* Performance-linked earning opportunities and long-term career growth.
* Company-supported official business travel and market development activities.

Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Cold Email Lead Generation Executive** who can build accurate B2B prospect lists, identify decision-makers, and execute targeted cold email campaigns that generate qualified business opportunities.

This role combines **lead research, email data enrichment, list verification, campaign management, and email deliverability**. The goal is to reach relevant prospects, generate positive replies, and deliver qualified leads to the sales team—not simply send large volumes of emails.

What You’ll Do

**1. B2B Lead Research & Data Extraction**

* Extract business information from Google Maps, online directories, company websites, LinkedIn, and other relevant public sources.
* Build targeted prospect lists based on industry, location, business type, company size, and other criteria.
* Identify key decision-makers, including founders, owners, directors, CEOs, and marketing heads.
* Find and enrich business email addresses using prospecting tools, databases, and AI-powered solutions.

**2. Email Finding, Verification & List Management**

* Verify email addresses before launching campaigns to reduce bounce rates.
* Clean, deduplicate, segment, and maintain prospect databases.
* Enrich incomplete records with relevant company and contact information.
* Keep prospect lists organized and updated for accurate targeting.

**3. Cold Email Campaign Setup & Management**

* Set up and manage sending domains, email inboxes, and campaign infrastructure.
* Configure and monitor SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication.
* Manage inbox warm-up and follow good deliverability practices to protect sender reputation.
* Create and run targeted cold email campaigns with personalized messaging and automated follow-ups.
* Use AI tools to support prospect research, personalization, and campaign workflows where appropriate.

**4. Email Deliverability & Performance Optimization**

* Monitor bounce rates, spam complaints, inbox placement, and reply rates.
* Identify and resolve deliverability issues promptly.
* Test subject lines, email copy, calls to action, audience segments, and targeting.
* Continuously improve campaign performance based on data and results.

**5. Lead Qualification & Reporting**

* Monitor responses and identify positive replies and potential business opportunities.
* Qualify interested prospects and pass relevant leads to the sales team.
* Maintain campaign records and report on verified prospects, deliverability, positive replies, and qualified leads.
* Maintain unsubscribe and suppression lists and follow applicable email marketing and privacy requirements.

Tools & Platforms

Google Maps, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Hunter, Snov.io, RocketReach, Lusha, email verification tools, Instantly, Smartlead, lemlist, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, CRM platforms, Excel, Google Sheets, and AI-powered research and automation tools.

Experience

Experience in cold email outreach, B2B lead generation, email prospecting, campaign management, or email deliverability is preferred. Candidates should understand prospect research, email verification, campaign execution, and performance tracking. Practical experience with cold email tools and domain authentication is an advantage.

Who Can Apply

* Candidates with experience in B2B lead generation or cold email campaign management.
* Candidates skilled in online research, data extraction, email finding, and verification.
* Individuals who understand email deliverability and can troubleshoot campaign issues.
* Detail-oriented professionals who can manage prospect databases and optimize campaigns using performance data.

Skills

* B2B prospect research and data extraction.
* Decision-maker identification and email enrichment.
* Email verification, database cleaning, and segmentation.
* Cold email campaign setup and management.
* Understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and sender reputation.
* Email deliverability monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Personalized email copy, follow-ups, and campaign testing.
* CRM, Excel, and Google Sheets proficiency.
* Familiarity with AI tools and workflow automation.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a focus on qualified leads rather than email volume.

**Lead Research Executive – B2B Prospect & Contact Research**

Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Lead Research Executive** to build accurate, relevant, and well-organized prospect lists for our sales and business development team.

The role involves researching businesses through Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, and other online sources; identifying business owners and decision-makers; verifying contact details; and spotting companies that may have a genuine need for digital marketing or related agency services.

The focus is on **lead quality, data accuracy, and prospect relevance—not simply collecting large volumes of random contacts.**

What You’ll Do

**1. Business & Prospect Research**

* Research businesses based on industry, location, company size, business type, and other defined criteria.
* Find relevant prospects using Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, and online directories.
* Identify businesses that match our target customer profile.

**2. Decision-Maker & Contact Research**

* Identify business owners, founders, directors, marketing heads, and other relevant decision-makers.

* Use reliable research and verification methods to improve contact accuracy.

**3. Identify High-Potential Prospects**

* Identify newly established businesses that may need digital marketing support.
* Research companies currently advertising online or showing signs of active marketing investment.
* Spot businesses with outdated websites, weak online visibility, or potential digital marketing gaps.
* Assess publicly available business information to identify prospects that may benefit from our services.
* Prioritize prospects based on relevance and potential need rather than adding every available business to the database.

**4. Data Verification & Database Management**

* Verify contact details and business information before adding them to prospect lists.
* Remove duplicate, outdated, incomplete, and irrelevant records.
* Organize prospects by industry, location, business category, and other research criteria.
* Maintain clean, structured, and consistently updated databases.
* Follow defined research guidelines to ensure data quality.

**5. Reporting & Team Coordination**

* Maintain prospect records in Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM systems.
* Track research progress, completed records, data accuracy, and prospect categories.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development team to clarify targeting requirements.
* Use feedback from the sales team to improve prospect selection and research quality.

Tools & Platforms

Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, online business directories, contact research and verification tools, Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM platforms.

Experience

Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.

Candidates with previous experience in lead research, data research, prospect research, B2B databases, contact research, market research, or lead generation will be preferred.

Strong online research skills, attention to detail, and data accuracy are essential for this role.

* Strong online research and information-gathering skills.

Job Description

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented **B2B Lead Generation Executive** who can identify relevant businesses, find the right decision-makers, and generate qualified sales opportunities through targeted research and personalized outreach.

The role involves prospect research, database building, cold outreach, follow-ups, and basic lead qualification. The objective is to create a consistent pipeline of **relevant, sales-ready prospects—not simply build large contact lists.**

What You’ll Do

**1. B2B Prospect Research**

* Research target businesses based on industry, location, company size, service requirements, and potential buying signals.
* Identify companies that match our ideal customer profile and may benefit from our services.
* Explore Google Search, Google Maps, LinkedIn, business directories, and other relevant sources to discover prospects.
* Monitor business activities and signals that may indicate a need for our services.

**2. Decision-Maker Identification & Data Verification**

* Identify key decision-makers, including founders, CEOs, directors, business owners, and marketing heads.
* Find and verify professional email addresses, phone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and company details.

**6. Tracking & Performance Reporting**

* Update lead status, outreach activity, responses, and follow-up schedules in the CRM or tracking sheet.

* Test new industries, audiences, data sources, and outreach strategies.

JOB DESCRIPTION

**Position:** CRM Executive - App Operations & Loyalty Programme Management

**Company:** Jolly Engineering Works

**Location:** Delhi

**Experience:** 2-5 years

**Department:** Marketing & Customer Relations

About the Role

Jolly Engineering Works is looking for a dynamic, responsible and tech-savvy professional to manage the **Jolly Saathi App**, our dedicated loyalty and engagement platform designed to strengthen relationships with our carpenter community.

This is a multifaceted role that combines app operations, customer relationship management, sales coordination, data management and administrative support.

The selected candidate will be responsible for the smooth day-to-day functioning of the app, from onboarding and verifying new users to managing loyalty points, redemptions, customer queries and ongoing engagement.

The role requires someone who is organised, approachable, patient and comfortable interacting with people from diverse backgrounds. We are looking for an individual who can take ownership of responsibilities, exercise sound judgement, coordinate effectively with different teams and contribute towards improving the overall user experience.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. App Operations & Management**

* Oversee the complete day-to-day administration and smooth functioning of the Jolly Saathi App.
* Manage new carpenter registrations, user onboarding, profile verification and KYC approvals.
* Review registration details, including geotagging and supporting information, to ensure authenticity and accuracy.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete or suspicious registrations and take appropriate corrective action.
* Manage loyalty points, redemption requests, approval processes and related customer queries.
* Maintain accurate records of user registrations, approvals, redemptions and pending requests.
* Coordinate with the app development and technical support teams to resolve operational issues, report bugs and implement updates.
* Monitor app activities and proactively identify areas where processes or the user experience can be improved.

2. Carpenter Engagement & Customer Relationship Management

* Act as a primary point of contact for carpenters using the Jolly Saathi App.
* Handle incoming queries, requests and complaints through phone calls, WhatsApp and email.
* Assist carpenters with registration, KYC documentation, loyalty points, redemption procedures and general app usage.
* Communicate patiently and clearly with users who may have limited familiarity with smartphones or digital applications.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with the carpenter community through consistent communication and timely support.
* Ensure queries and complaints are addressed efficiently, with appropriate follow-up until resolution.

3. Sales Team Coordination & Follow-ups

* Work closely with the internal sales team to support carpenter registrations and encourage active participation in the Jolly Saathi programme.
* Coordinate with sales representatives regarding new registrations, pending verifications and incomplete documentation.
* Follow up regularly with field teams to ensure registration targets and operational requirements are being addressed.
* Highlight discrepancies, delays or recurring issues to the relevant team members.
* Maintain effective communication between carpenters, sales representatives and management to ensure smooth coordination.
* Assist in implementing initiatives aimed at improving app adoption and engagement.

4. Reporting, MIS & Data Management

* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly and monthly reports using MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Monitor and track key app activities, including new registrations, KYC approvals, loyalty point redemptions, pending cases and active users.
* Maintain organised and updated databases, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality of information.
* Prepare reports, trackers, presentations and data summaries for management review.
* Analyse basic operational data to identify pending issues, trends and areas requiring attention.
* Ensure timely submission of reports and completion of assigned documentation.

5. Administrative & Marketing Support

* Provide administrative and coordination support to management on assigned projects and activities.
* Assist with preparing Excel sheets, compiling information, organising databases and maintaining work trackers.
* Support basic content creation and editing of product demonstration and installation videos using InShot or similar applications.
* Assist with marketing-related communication, documentation and other digital activities as required.
* Coordinate with internal departments and external service providers for assigned tasks.

Candidate Profile & Requirements Professional Experience

* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in CRM operations, customer support, app administration, loyalty programme management or a similar customer-facing role.
* Experience handling customer databases, verification processes or digital platforms will be an advantage.
* Prior exposure to coordination with field sales teams is desirable.

Technical & Digital Skills

* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets, including data management, reporting and basic formulas.
* Comfortable working with mobile applications, online dashboards and digital platforms.
* Proficiency in email communication, WhatsApp and routine office applications.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT and other AI tools for drafting communication, organising information and improving productivity.
* Basic knowledge of video editing applications such as InShot will be an added advantage.
* Ability and willingness to learn new software and digital tools.

Communication & Interpersonal Skills

* Strong verbal communication skills in Hindi and good working proficiency in English.
* Ability to communicate clearly, respectfully and patiently with different customer groups.
* Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to coordinate with internal sales teams and external stakeholders.
* Strong follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple conversations and responsibilities simultaneously.

Key Personal Attributes

We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates:

* **Integrity & Trustworthiness:** Maintains honesty, confidentiality and accuracy, particularly when handling customer verification, loyalty points and redemption approvals.
* **Presence of Mind & Judgement:** Can assess information, identify discrepancies and make sensible decisions independently within defined guidelines.
* **Patience & Empathy:** Has the ability to listen, understand and assist customers who may require additional guidance.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** Takes responsibility for assigned work, follows through on commitments and ensures timely resolution of issues.
* **Proactive Approach:** Identifies pending tasks, follows up without constant supervision and takes initiative when required.
* **Organisation & Time Management:** Can prioritise multiple responsibilities, maintain accurate records and meet deadlines.
* **Adaptability & Willingness to Learn:** Is comfortable taking on varied responsibilities and adapting to evolving systems and processes.

Preferred Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Experience in CRM, loyalty programme operations, customer engagement or back-office management.
* Experience in MIS reporting and customer database management.
* Exposure to mobile app administration or customer verification processes.
* Basic knowledge of content editing and digital marketing support activities.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working with people while being equally comfortable managing data, technology and operational processes.

We value individuals who are dependable, resourceful and willing to take initiative. The ability to work independently, maintain strong relationships and approach challenges with patience and practical problem-solving skills is essential.

This role offers exposure to customer engagement, digital loyalty programme management, sales coordination and marketing operations within an established architectural hardware company.

* Maintain accurate records using Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

* Communicate professionally with clients regarding marketplace performance.
* Understand client requirements and business objectives.
* Provide regular updates on completed tasks, account issues, and growth opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely execution.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Minimum 1 year of practical experience** managing Amazon and Flipkart seller accounts.

* Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.

* Understanding of marketplace advertising metrics such as ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rate.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, analytical, and focused on results rather than simply completing daily operational tasks.

The candidate should be capable of independently managing marketplace accounts, identifying growth opportunities, optimizing advertising campaigns, and contributing directly to clients' sales performance.

title: Sales Consultant – Home Décor
description:
**About MahattaArt**

Mahatta Art is a premium wall décor solutions company helping homes, offices, hospitality spaces, designers, and businesses create finished, considered, and visually strong spaces.

We work across wallpapers, wall art, print-to-frame solutions, custom framing, collage sets, hospitality décor, and project-based wall solutions. Our role is not only to supply products, but to help customers make better decisions for their walls and spaces.

Mahatta Art combines design guidance, curated products, customization, in-house production, installation coordination, and AI-assisted wall design through Nur.

Mahatta Art was formed by bringing together two strengths from within the Mahatta Group: over 100 years of Mahatta’s photography, printing, and craft expertise, and 15+ years of IndiaPicture’s technology and online commerce experience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Sales Consultant – Home Décor** with experience in home décor, furniture, furnishings, wall art, framing or a related industry.

The role involves handling customer enquiries, understanding their requirements, recommending suitable wall décor products and helping customers make informed purchase decisions.

You will work across MahattaArt products such as **Wallpaper, Wall Art, Frames, Print-to-Frame, Collages and other wall décor products**, with a particular focus on framing, artwork and customised photo framing solutions.

This is a **customer-facing sales and product consultation role**. We are looking for someone with good aesthetic sense, strong communication skills and the ability to guide customers from enquiry through to purchase.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle customer enquiries received through the website, WhatsApp, phone and other digital channels.
* Understand customer requirements, space, budget and aesthetic preferences.
* Recommend suitable wall décor products based on customer needs.
* Guide customers on colours, materials, sizes, finishes, frame styles and product combinations.
* Assist customers in selecting artwork, frames, mounts, glass, printing options and collage layouts.
* Advise customers on appropriate artwork sizes and frame arrangements for their walls.
* Explain product features, pricing, customisation and ordering options.
* Follow up with interested customers, address objections and **convert enquiries into orders**.
* Independently close routine customer orders and coordinate with the Sales Manager for complex enquiries.
* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling suitable products.
* Ensure customer orders are accurately configured before being sent to Production, including dimensions, materials and other specifications.
* Coordinate with Production and internal teams for order-related requirements.
* Maintain customer records, enquiry status, follow-ups and sales updates in the CRM.
* Track recurring customer requirements, product-related questions and feedback.
* Research home décor trends, competitor products, pricing and customer preferences.
* Share relevant customer feedback and product improvement suggestions with the Sales, Product and Marketing teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

**2–4 years of customer-facing sales or product consultation experience**, preferably in:

* Home Décor & Home Furnishings
* Furniture & Premium Home Retail
* Wall Art & Custom Framing
* Art Galleries & Photography Printing
* Wallpaper & Home Improvement
* Interior Décor & Styling
* Design-led Lifestyle Brands

Candidates who have experience helping customers select products, making aesthetic recommendations, following up on enquiries and closing sales will be preferred.

Prior experience in custom framing or Print-to-Frame is an advantage but not mandatory. Product-specific training will be provided.

**Skills Required**

* Good aesthetic sense and understanding of colours, materials, proportions and finishes.
* Strong customer communication and consultation skills.
* Ability to recommend suitable products and confidently close sales.
* Good follow-up, negotiation and objection-handling skills.
* Strong product understanding and attention to detail.
* Ability to explain product options, pricing and customisation clearly.
* Comfortable communicating with customers over phone and WhatsApp.
* Ability to understand customer budgets and recommend appropriate alternatives.
* Comfortable using CRM systems, websites and basic digital tools.
* Ability to conduct basic competitor and product research.
* Interest in home décor, wall art, framing and interior styling.
* Willingness to learn and develop detailed product knowledge.

We are seeking an accomplished, commercially aware Executive Chef to lead all culinary operations across a multi-cuisine restaurant. The role requires the ability to maintain consistent quality across kitchen sections, develop commercially successful menus, build a high-performing team and deliver an excellent guest experience.

· Oversee recipe costing, menu engineering, purchasing, supplier negotiations, receiving standards, stock rotation and inventory audits.

· Control food wastage, monitor portion sizes and reduce avoidable costs without compromising quality.

· Maintain compliance with applicable FSSAI requirements and internal standards for hygiene, sanitation, allergen handling, food storage and temperature control.

· Conduct regular kitchen inspections and ensure equipment is safe, clean, maintained and fit for use.

· Coordinate with restaurant operations, service, bar, sales and events teams to plan launches, promotions, guest experiences and special occasions.

· Review guest feedback, resolve food-related complaints and use feedback and sales data to improve menus and service.

· Monitor kitchen performance through regular reporting on food costs, wastage, sales mix, quality, staffing and guest satisfaction.

· Stay informed about culinary trends, techniques, ingredient developments and competitor offerings relevant to the restaurant.

· Formal culinary qualification or equivalent professional training preferred.

· 10–15+ years of professional kitchen experience, including substantial experience leading multi-cuisine operations.

· Broad practical knowledge of Indian and international cuisines offered by the establishment.

· Proven ability to lead specialist section chefs while maintaining a consistent overall culinary standard.

· Strong menu development, recipe standardisation, menu engineering and food-costing skills.

· Demonstrated experience in inventory control, purchasing, supplier management and wastage reduction.

· Strong people-management, coaching, communication and problem-solving skills.

· Sound understanding of food safety, hygiene, allergen management and applicable regulatory requirements.

· Ability to perform effectively in a high-volume, guest-focused restaurant environment.

· Commercial awareness and the ability to balance culinary creativity with profitability.

· Guest satisfaction, food reviews and resolution of food-related complaints.

· Food-cost percentage, gross margin and menu profitability against agreed targets.

· Procurement and Stores: supplier quality, pricing, stock levels and purchasing.

· Restaurant Service and Events Teams: menu communication, special requests, private dining and event delivery.

Role Expectations

The Executive Chef is accountable for the overall culinary performance of the restaurant. The role requires hands-on leadership, structured systems and the ability to delegate specialist cuisine execution to qualified section leaders. The chef should combine creativity and authenticity with disciplined operational management, financial accountability and a guest-first approach.

description:
Cold Email Lead Generation Executive – B2B Prospecting & Email Deliverability

Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Cold Email Lead Generation Executive** to build targeted B2B prospect lists, identify decision-makers, verify business email addresses, and run effective cold email campaigns that generate qualified leads.

This role combines **B2B lead generation, data extraction, email research, list enrichment, cold email campaign management, and email deliverability**. You will use prospecting platforms, verification tools, automation, and AI-powered workflows to reach relevant businesses and start meaningful sales conversations.

The goal is to generate quality business opportunities through accurate data, personalized outreach, strong inbox placement, and continuous campaign optimization—not simply to send a high volume of emails.

What You’ll Do1. B2B Data Extraction & Prospect Research

* Extract business information from Google Maps, online directories, company websites, LinkedIn, and other publicly available sources.
* Build targeted prospect lists based on industry, location, business type, company size, and ideal customer profile.
* Identify key decision-makers, including Founders, Business Owners, Directors, CEOs, and Marketing Heads.
* Research company details and enrich existing prospect databases using data enrichment and AI tools.
* Organize prospect information into structured lists for accurate targeting and personalized outreach.

2. Email Finding, Verification & Database Management

* Find business email addresses using email discovery platforms and prospecting tools.
* Verify email addresses before campaigns to reduce invalid contacts and unnecessary bounces.
* Clean, deduplicate, segment, and maintain prospect databases.
* Identify missing information and improve list quality through data enrichment.
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, contact details, campaign status, and lead qualification.

3. Cold Email Campaign Setup & Deliverability

* Set up and manage sending domains, email inboxes, and campaign infrastructure.
* Configure and monitor email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Manage appropriate inbox warm-up practices and monitor sender reputation.
* Follow deliverability best practices to improve the likelihood of emails reaching recipients’ inboxes.
* Monitor inbox placement, bounce rates, spam complaints, and sending performance.
* Identify deliverability issues and take corrective action to maintain campaign health.

4. Cold Email Outreach & Automation

* Create and manage cold email campaigns targeting relevant businesses and decision-makers.
* Write or adapt personalized email copy based on the prospect’s industry, role, business needs, and potential challenges.
* Segment prospect lists and tailor messaging to different audiences.
* Set up automated follow-up sequences with appropriate timing and personalization.
* Use AI writing tools and automation platforms to improve research, personalization, and campaign efficiency.
* Ensure outreach remains relevant, professional, and aligned with applicable email marketing and privacy requirements.

5. Campaign Monitoring & Optimization

* Track email delivery, bounce rates, replies, positive responses, and qualified leads.
* Test subject lines, email copy, calls to action, audience segments, and targeting approaches.
* Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve reply rates and lead quality.
* Troubleshoot campaign and deliverability problems promptly.
* Track positive replies and pass qualified prospects to the sales team with relevant context.
* Maintain unsubscribe and suppression lists and ensure opted-out contacts are excluded from future campaigns.
* Prepare regular reports on prospect data quality, campaign performance, deliverability, and lead generation results.

Tools & Platforms

* Google Maps and online business directories
* Apollo.io and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Clay, Hunter, Snov.io, and RocketReach
* Lusha and email verification tools
* Instantly, Smartlead, and lemlist
* Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
* CRM and lead management systems
* Excel and Google Sheets
* AI-powered research, writing, and automation tools

Experience

Experience in cold email lead generation, B2B prospecting, email research, data extraction, email marketing, campaign management, or email deliverability is preferred.

Candidates with practical knowledge of prospect list building, email verification, campaign setup, and outreach optimization are encouraged to apply. Relevant hands-on skills and the ability to learn new tools are important.

Who Can Apply

* Freshers and experienced candidates interested in B2B lead generation and cold email outreach.
* Candidates who can research businesses and identify relevant decision-makers.
* Individuals who understand email finding, verification, list cleaning, and prospect segmentation.
* Candidates interested in cold email campaign setup, automation, and deliverability.
* People who can write clear, professional, and personalized business emails in English.
* Candidates who are comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, CRM systems, and multiple prospecting tools.
* Individuals who pay close attention to data accuracy, campaign performance, and follow-up processes.
* Candidates willing to learn email authentication, deliverability monitoring, AI-powered research, and campaign optimization.

Skills Required

* B2B lead generation and prospect research
* Business data extraction and list building
* Decision-maker identification
* Email finding, verification, and enrichment
* Database cleaning, deduplication, and segmentation
* Cold email campaign setup and management
* Email deliverability and sender reputation monitoring
* Basic understanding of SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
* Personalized email copy and automated follow-ups
* Campaign analytics and A/B testing
* CRM, Excel, and Google Sheets
* AI tools and marketing automation
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and time management
* Awareness of email marketing, unsubscribe management, and privacy practices

Role Objective & Success Metrics

Success in this role is measured by:

* Accurate, verified, and well-targeted prospect lists.
* Healthy email deliverability and controlled bounce rates.
* Relevant, personalized cold email campaigns.
* Positive replies and meaningful conversations with potential clients.

We are looking for a detail-oriented **B2B Lead Generation Executive** to identify potential business customers, research key decision-makers, build accurate prospect databases, and generate qualified sales opportunities through targeted outreach.

In this role, you will research businesses based on industry, location, company size, business needs, and buying signals. You will use lead generation tools, professional networking platforms, email outreach, and follow-up strategies to connect with relevant prospects and support the sales team.

The focus is on **lead quality, relevant conversations, and qualified sales opportunities—not simply building large contact lists.**

What You’ll Do1. B2B Prospect Research

* Research target businesses based on industry, location, company size, service requirements, and ideal customer profile.
* Identify potential customers using Google Search, Google Maps, business directories, LinkedIn, and lead generation platforms.
* Look for buying signals, business expansion, hiring activity, and other indicators that suggest a potential need for our services.
* Build targeted prospect lists aligned with business objectives and sales priorities.

2. Decision-Maker Identification & Data Verification

* Identify relevant decision-makers, including Founders, CEOs, Directors, Business Owners, and Marketing Heads.
* Find and verify professional contact details, including business email addresses, phone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and company information.
* Use prospecting and email verification tools to improve data accuracy.
* Research company websites and business profiles to understand each prospect’s services, market, and potential requirements.
* Maintain accurate contact records and remove duplicate, invalid, or outdated information.

3. Lead Database Building & Management

* Build, clean, organize, and segment B2B prospect databases.
* Categorize leads by industry, location, company size, decision-maker role, and potential service requirements.
* Maintain consistent data quality across spreadsheets and CRM systems.
* Update prospect information as new details become available.
* Ensure the sales team receives organized, relevant, and usable lead data.

4. Outreach & Follow-Up

* Run personalized cold email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns to relevant business prospects.
* Use WhatsApp for professional follow-ups where appropriate and permitted.
* Personalize outreach based on the prospect’s business, role, potential challenges, and service needs.
* Manage follow-up sequences for prospects who have not responded.
* Respond professionally to enquiries and maintain consistent communication with interested prospects.
* Use AI research and outreach tools to improve personalization and productivity without compromising message quality.

5. Lead Qualification & Sales Coordination

* Review prospect responses to identify genuine interest and potential business opportunities.
* Qualify leads based on their requirements, relevance, interest, and fit with the services offered.
* Schedule meetings with interested prospects or transfer qualified leads to the sales team.
* Record conversations, lead status, next steps, and follow-up dates in the CRM or tracking sheet.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand which leads convert and refine prospecting criteria accordingly.

6. Performance Tracking & Optimization

* Track prospects researched, verified contacts, outreach activity, responses, meetings booked, and qualified leads.
* Test new industries, target audiences, prospecting sources, and messaging approaches.
* Identify which channels and research methods generate the best-quality opportunities.
* Use feedback from the sales team to improve targeting, qualification, and lead generation processes.

description:
**You will be responsible for:**
================================

**1. Regional Business Strategy & Growth**
------------------------------------------

* Drive the development and execution of the regional business strategy for the Farm Replacement Sales business, leveraging market potential, industry dynamics, competitive intelligence, pricing trends, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and strengthen Goodyear’s competitive position.
* Translate business priorities into robust annual operating plans (AOPs), sales forecasts, and regional growth projections, ensuring alignment with national business objectives, market realities, and long-term growth ambitions.
* Identify priority markets, high-potential territories, and emerging business segments to accelerate regional expansion, strengthen market penetration, and deliver sustainable volume and revenue growth.
* Lead periodic business reviews to evaluate performance against planned objectives, identify gaps and emerging risks, and implement corrective strategies to ensure consistent achievement of regional business targets.

**2. Sales Planning & Commercial Performance**
----------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute comprehensive regional sales plans covering volume growth, pricing, profitable product mix, inventory planning, distribution strategy, and resource allocation to maximize business performance.
* Translate approved business plans into actionable territory-level objectives, ensuring effective deployment of sales resources, clear accountability, and disciplined execution across the regional sales organization.
* Monitor sales performance against forecasts and operating plans, proactively identifying variances and driving timely corrective interventions to optimize sales productivity, profitability, and target achievement.
* Evaluate market pricing, product positioning, and competitive offerings to recommend commercially viable sales strategies that balance volume growth, margin delivery, and long-term business sustainability.

**3. Market Development & Share Expansion**
-------------------------------------------

* Assess regional market potential and competitive dynamics to identify underpenetrated territories, emerging customer segments, and opportunities to expand Goodyear’s presence in the Farm Replacement market.
* Develop and strengthen the regional dealer and distribution network by identifying new channel partners, optimizing market coverage, and enhancing the productivity and effectiveness of existing distribution channels.
* Drive initiatives to improve Share of Market (SOM) and Share of Accounts (SOA), strengthen customer engagement, and increase brand preference through targeted market development strategies and focused field execution.
* Establish effective market intelligence mechanisms to capture field-level insights on customer behavior, competitor activities, pricing movements, and evolving market requirements, translating insights into actionable business strategies.
* Partner with the National Head – Sales to provide data-driven market assessments, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations that support regional growth and national business priorities.

**4. Marketing Alignment & Brand Development**
----------------------------------------------

* Partner with Marketing and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate regional market requirements into actionable marketing strategies, customer engagement initiatives, and demand-generation programmes.
* Drive the development and execution of regional sales schemes, trade promotions, and brand-building initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities and measurable impact on primary and secondary sales.
* Oversee the development and performance of branded retail outlets and other customer-facing initiatives to strengthen brand visibility, improve customer experience, and enhance Goodyear’s positioning in the regional market.
* Monitor the effectiveness of marketing interventions, promotional investments, and brand activation initiatives, recommending improvements to maximize business impact and return on investment.

**5. Channel Management & Distribution Excellence**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead the strategic development and optimization of the regional dealer and distributor ecosystem, ensuring appropriate market coverage, channel capability, and alignment with business growth objectives.
* Evaluate, approve, and onboard dealers in accordance with established policies and business requirements, while continuously assessing channel performance, commercial viability, and growth potential.
* Drive effective inventory planning, stock availability, and inventory liquidation strategies across the distribution network to maintain healthy channel inventory, improve product availability, and minimize business risks.
* Monitor distributor and carrying and forwarding (C&F) operations for compliance with company policies, operational standards, and agreed business processes.
* Develop strong relationships with key distributors, dealers, and strategic channel partners to improve engagement, strengthen commercial partnerships, and create a sustainable foundation for regional business expansion.
* Collaborate with service and technical teams to address customer requirements, improve service responsiveness, and enhance the overall effectiveness of the regional distribution ecosystem.

**6. Financial Discipline & Profitable Business Growth**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Drive regional commercial performance by closely monitoring sales realization, collections, outstanding receivables, credit exposure, and other key financial indicators to ensure healthy cash flow and sustainable business growth.
* Partner with the Zonal Finance Manager and relevant stakeholders to strengthen collection discipline, address overdue accounts, evaluate commercial risks, and establish appropriate corrective measures.
* Monitor primary and secondary sales performance against projections, ensuring alignment between market demand, distributor inventory, sales execution, and financial objectives.
* Evaluate the commercial effectiveness of dealer discounts, regional schemes, and promotional investments, ensuring appropriate governance, financial discipline, and measurable business returns.
* Identify opportunities to improve regional profitability through disciplined pricing, optimized product mix, effective inventory management, and stronger commercial decision-making.

**7. People Leadership & Organizational Capability**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop the regional sales organization by establishing a clear strategic direction, translating business priorities into individual objectives, and fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and performance excellence.
* Build a high-performing sales team by identifying capability gaps, strengthening sales effectiveness, and implementing structured coaching, mentoring, and development interventions aligned with current and future business requirements.
* Establish a robust performance management framework through regular business reviews, field assessments, and individual performance discussions, ensuring clear expectations, objective evaluation, and timely performance interventions.
* Develop the leadership capabilities of direct reports and strengthen the regional talent pipeline through succession planning, talent reviews, cross-functional exposure, and targeted development opportunities.
* Drive the adoption of structured sales processes, effective field-force management practices, and appropriate digital tools to enhance team productivity, improve market execution, and strengthen data-driven decision-making.
* Foster collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Technical Service teams to ensure seamless execution of regional priorities and a unified approach to business growth.

**8. Business Governance & Execution Excellence**
-------------------------------------------------

* Establish effective operating rhythms, performance dashboards, and review mechanisms to monitor key business metrics, including volume achievement, sales growth, market share, channel expansion, collections, inventory health, and team productivity.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, commercial guidelines, and established operating processes across the regional sales network, maintaining appropriate governance and business controls.
* Proactively identify regional business risks, operational bottlenecks, and emerging market challenges, developing contingency plans and mitigation strategies to safeguard business continuity and target achievement.
* Provide timely, actionable business updates and strategic recommendations to national leadership, enabling informed decision-making, effective resource allocation, and continuous improvement in regional performance.
