**Job Title** : Account (Sales) Support Executive


**Location:** New Delhi


**About Springer Nature**

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology\-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.


**About the Brand** 

Springer is a leading global scientific, technical and medical portfolio, providing researchers in academia, scientific institutions and corporate R\&D departments with quality content through innovative information, products and services. Springer has one of the strongest STM and HSS eBook collections and archives, as well as a comprehensive range of hybrid and open access journals. Visit springer.com and follow @Springer1842


**About the Role**

This position will report to the **Account Support Manager, Sales Operations** . The Account Support Executive fulfils a central role within the company and works closely with the sales team the customers and other internal stakeholders to prepare subscription (license) agreements for new and renewal business for online products accurately and in line with established targets. In doing so, the goal is to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction in managing internal and external relationships.
  

The role of an Account Support Executive is vital to the business and has direct impact on customer satisfaction. The account support role is continuously enhanced by team training and by facilitating personal development.


**Job Responsibilities:**

* Generate reports and analysis on renewal sales progress for assigned region, leveraging Data Analytics / Quantitative Skills to provide insights and support informed decision\-making.
* Prepare renewals and planning (i.e. calculate journal licenses, calculate eBook quotes), demonstrating strong Action\-Oriented behavior and Drives Results focus to ensure timely renewal readiness.
* Prepare (in CRM/ERP system) the quote and contract to trigger invoicing, applying strong Product and Service Knowledge and attention to detail.
* Ensure accurate invoicing and documentation to customers, exercising sound Decision Quality and maintaining high standards of accuracy.
* Provide first\-level support to sales and customers on license agreement changes and amendments, using Consultative Selling skills and Product and Service Knowledge to address customer needs effectively.
* Be the first point of contact for customers regarding contract execution, fulfillment, and invoicing, demonstrating strong Collaboration and customer service capabilities.
* Coordinate all customer correspondence and agreements within the assigned region, utilizing Project Management, Collaboration, and Organizational Savvy to manage multiple stakeholders effectively.
* Proactively communicate with customers, align new contract terms and agreed fees, and obtain the customer’s signed license, applying Consultative Selling, Collaboration, and a strong customer\-focused approach.
* Manage customer requests and provide assistance on daily operations (i.e. engage with customers to enhance customer data quality, answer questions connected to contract data or invoicing data), demonstrating Action\-Oriented behavior and strong stakeholder management skills.
* Provide feedback and proposals to improve sales and support workflows (in systems) to work more effectively and efficiently, leveraging Marketing Performance \& Automatization, Data Analytics / Quantitative Skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Maintain excellent knowledge of the Salesforce CRM system and safeguard data quality in CRM, utilizing Data Analytics / Quantitative Skills and strong operational discipline.
* Reporting: Work with Sales to plan, drive, and track quarterly and yearly renewal closures, including large renewal management, demonstrating Project Management, Drives Results, Collaboration, and Decision Quality.

**Skills, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2–7 years of experience in sales support or account support, preferably in the publishing industry.
* Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and analytical skills.
* Good team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing customer expectations and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong computer skills, including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Good knowledge of Salesforce CRM and commitment to maintaining accurate data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.

At Springer Nature, we value the diversity of our teams and work to build an inclusive culture, where people are treated fairly and can bring their differences to work and thrive. We empower our colleagues and value their diverse perspectives as we strive to attract, nurture and develop the very best talent.

title: Business Operations Executive
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised and communication\-focused professional to manage the **end\-to\-end sales, onboarding, compliance and post\-sales operations** for our Pan\-India Virtual Office business.

The role involves speaking with leads, onboarding coworking partners across India, coordinating agreements and e\-stamps, managing documentation, ensuring timely delivery of Virtual Office services, handling renewals and coordinating with internal teams.

This role requires someone who can **take ownership of a task from start to finish**. No communication should remain unanswered, no document should remain pending without follow\-up, and no task should be allowed to become a backlog.

Key Responsibilities1\. Pan\-India Virtual Office Sales

* Handle and follow up with leads generated for Pan\-India Virtual Office plans.
* Understand client requirements and explain available Virtual Office solutions clearly.
* Coordinate with clients over calls, WhatsApp and email throughout the sales process.
* Maintain accurate lead and communication records.
* Follow up consistently until the lead is converted, closed or clearly marked as lost.
* Ensure there are no unattended or pending client communications.

2\. Partner Onboarding – Pan India

* Identify, communicate with and onboard coworking spaces/service providers across India for Virtual Office collaborations.
* Coordinate with prospective partners to understand their locations, facilities, documentation and commercial terms.
* Take the onboarding process from initial discussion to final documentation and activation.
* Ensure all required information and documents are collected and properly recorded.
* Maintain a clean and updated database of all Virtual Office partners.

3\. Agreements \& Compliance

* Coordinate the complete agreement process with clients and Virtual Office partners.
* Prepare/coordinate agreements, e\-stamps and other required documentation.
* Get agreements and documents signed by all relevant stakeholders.
* Track every document from initiation to completion.
* Ensure documents are executed correctly and within defined timelines.
* Maintain organised records of agreements, KYC documents, e\-stamps, invoices and other compliance\-related documents.
* Follow up proactively on pending signatures or documentation.

4\. End\-to\-End Virtual Office Delivery

* Manage the complete post\-sales delivery process for Virtual Office clients across India.
* Coordinate between clients, Virtual Office providers and internal teams.
* Ensure required documents and services are delivered within the committed timeline.
* Track every active case until final delivery and closure.
* Identify delays early and take corrective action instead of allowing cases to remain pending.

5\. Renewals \& Existing Client Management

* Send renewal communications to existing coworking and Virtual Office clients.
* Maintain renewal trackers and follow up with clients before expiry.
* Coordinate internally to ensure renewals are processed on time.
* Handle post\-sales communication and ensure existing clients receive timely support.

6\. Invoicing \& Accounts Coordination

* Coordinate closely with the Accounts team for timely and accurate invoice generation and delivery.
* Ensure the correct invoice is delivered to the correct client without unnecessary delays.
* Track pending invoices and follow up with the concerned internal team.
* Ensure there is no avoidable backlog in invoicing or client documentation.

7\. Coworking Sales Support

* Handle coworking sales enquiries over calls when required.
* Understand the client's requirement and provide relevant information about available coworking solutions.
* Follow up with prospects and coordinate visits/bookings where required.
* Support the sales team during periods of high lead volume.

8\. Records, Tracking \& Closure

* Maintain clean and updated records of leads, clients, partners, agreements, documents, renewals and pending actions.
* Keep trackers updated on a real\-time basis.
* Maintain proper naming, filing and documentation of all relevant records.
* Ensure every task has a clear status, owner and next action.
* Close communications and tasks within the defined timeline.
* Escalate issues when required instead of allowing them to remain unresolved.

What We Are Looking For

**Communication is the highest priority for this role.**

The candidate must have:

* Excellent **spoken English** with confidence in professional conversations.
* Excellent **written English** for emails, WhatsApp communication and documentation.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to communicate professionally with clients, business owners, coworking operators and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly with documents and compliance\-related work.
* Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously without losing track of pending tasks.
* Strong ownership and a clear **closure\-oriented mindset**.
* Ability to work with defined timelines and deadlines.
* Fast learning ability and willingness to understand new processes, tools and business requirements.
* Good organisational and record\-keeping skills.
* Ability to work independently once the process is understood.

The Person We Expect

We are looking for someone who:

* Does not wait to be reminded about pending work.
* Follows up until the task is actually completed.
* Can handle multiple conversations without losing context.
* Understands that a message, document or client request should not remain open unnecessarily.
* Is comfortable speaking to people across different cities and business backgrounds.
* Can learn processes quickly and execute them consistently.
* Takes responsibility for the complete outcome rather than only completing their part of a task.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Timely closure of leads and client communications.
* Conversion and follow\-up quality for Virtual Office enquiries.
* Successful onboarding of Pan\-India Virtual Office partners.
* Timely completion of agreements, e\-stamps and signatures.
* Timely delivery of Virtual Office services and documentation.
* Accuracy and completeness of records.
* Timely renewal follow\-ups.
* Coordination with Accounts for timely and accurate invoicing.
* Minimal pending/backlog of work.
* Overall ability to manage a case from **first communication to final closure**.

Core Skills

**Must Have**

* Excellent spoken English
* Excellent written English
* Client communication
* Sales follow\-up
* Documentation \& compliance coordination
* Strong follow\-up skills
* Record keeping
* Task and timeline management
* Ability to learn quickly

**Good to Have**

* Experience in coworking, Virtual Office, real estate, B2B sales, business services or client operations
* Experience handling agreements, KYC or compliance documentation
* Experience working with CRM/ERP systems
* Basic understanding of invoicing and accounts coordination

title: Sales Manager
description:
Candidates with Interior Architecture / Design backgrounds OR 5\+ years in Commercial Workspace Design \& Build Sales only will be eligible.



**Role Definition**


The Sales Manager is responsible for converting qualified high\-intent leads—sourced via divineinnovation.com, digital campaigns, and the Business Development Manager—into signed design \& build contracts. Acting as a trusted workspace consultant, this professional evaluates client space requirements, leads design solution pitches, defends techno\-commercial proposals (BOQs), and secures high\-value corporate revenue for Divine Innovation.

**Responsibilities \& Deliverables**

* **Inbound Lead Discovery \& Need Assessment:** Meet prospective corporate clients to conduct detailed space requirement analysis, understand design aesthetics, headcount plans, and budget parameters.
* **Solution Pitching \& Design Alignment:** Present space planning concepts, 3D visual directions, material finishes, and in\-house modular furniture capabilities (manufactured at Divine Innovation's IMT Manesar plant) to key decision\-makers.
* **Techno\-Commercial Proposal Management:** Collaborate with internal space planners, interior architects, and estimation teams to prepare transparent, competitive Bill of Quantities (BOQs) and project proposals.
* **Negotiation \& Deal Closure:** Address client objections, defend value propositions against competitors, negotiate commercial terms, and secure signed execution agreements.

 **Tasks and Activities**

**1\. Inbound Lead Discovery \& Need Assessment**

* Conduct initial meetings (virtual or in\-person) with leads generated via divineinnovation.com and internal BD handovers within 24 hours of qualification.
* Analyze client floor plans, structural layouts, corporate branding guidelines, and functional workflow requirements.
* Determine key decision\-makers, decision criteria, target project completion timelines, and allocated fit\-out budgets.

**2\. Solution Pitching \& Design Alignment**

* Translate client briefs into actionable design directions in coordination with internal space planners and design teams.
* Present customized design concepts, mood boards, workspace layouts, and ergonomic furniture systems to CXOs, Admin Heads, and Real Estate Committees.
* Demonstrate Divine Innovation’s complete turnkey strength, highlighting quality controls, timeline guarantees, and factory\-backed customization from IMT Manesar.

**3\. Techno\-Commercial Proposal Management**

* Work with estimation and design teams to build accurate, detailed BOQs covering civil, MEP, interior finishes, loose furniture, and custom workstations.
* Conduct joint walkthroughs of the BOQ with the client to explain line\-item specifications, material quality, and value engineering options.
* Ensure proposals reflect Divine Innovation’s target profitability margins while remaining competitive in the market.

**4\. Negotiation \& Deal Closure**

* Navigate commercial negotiations, payment milestones, and contractual terms with client procurement teams.
* Counter price\-based objections by emphasizing long\-term durability, factory finish quality, and single\-point turnkey accountability and other value propositions.
* Finalize contract execution and handover signed agreements to the Design and Project Execution team with complete project documentation.

 **Measurement Metrics**

* **Inbound Lead Conversion Rate:** Achieve a minimum 25% to 30% conversion rate from qualified inbound leads to signed contracts.
* **Quarterly Closed Revenue:** Generate ₹2\.5 Cr to ₹4 Cr in signed design \& build revenue quarterly.
* **Gross Profit Margin Maintenance:** Maintain target gross profit margins across all closed contracts without unjustified commercial discounting.
* **Sales Cycle Velocity:** Maintain an average duration of 21 to 45 days from first client discovery meeting to contract signature.

 **Competencies We Are Looking For**

**Skills**

* B2B Consultative Solution Selling \& Value\-Based Pitching
* Architectural CAD Layout Reading \& Space Planning Analysis
* BOQ Commercial Defense \& Margin Negotiation
* High\-Impact Client Presentation \& Executive Presence
* Objection Handling \& Strategic Deal Closure
* Client Relationship Nurturing \& Account Retention

**Knowledge**

* Deep knowledge of Commercial Workspace Fit\-out Costs, MEP basics, and interior materials
* Thorough understanding of modular office furniture systems and manufacturing workflows
* Familiarity with corporate procurement cycles, tender processes, and commercial contracts
* Proficiency in CRM management, estimation tools, and presentation software

**Self\-Image**

* Trusted Workspace Solutions Advisor
* Design\-Oriented B2B Sales Professional
* High\-Value Deal Closer

**Traits**

* Articulate and persuasive communicator
* Empathetic listener with high spatial awareness
* Detail\-oriented and commercially sharp
* High integrity and solution\-focused mindset

**Motives**

* Driven by closing high\-ticket corporate contracts and achieving revenue targets
* Passionate about transforming physical work environments for corporate clients
* Motivated by creating long\-term client trust and satisfaction

title: Head of Design
description:
Candidates with a minimum of 10\+ years of dedicated experience in Commercial Office Interior Architecture \& Design only eligible.


**Role Definition**


The Head of Design holds total executive accountability for the creative vision, technical accuracy, commercial viability, and execution readiness of every design project at Divine Innovation. Directing a full multidisciplinary studio—including interior architects, 3D visualizers, furniture designers, proposal writers, and BOQ estimators—this leader translates sales downloads into awe\-inspiring, budget\-aligned workspace environments. The Head of Design personally checks all drawing packages to ensure 100% zero\-ambiguity handovers to project execution and purchase teams, while co\-leading design pitches to leave enterprise clients flabbergasted.

**Responsibilities \& Deliverables**

* **Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching:** Lead the design studio in crafting innovative commercial office concepts, while personally joining the Sales team to present and defend high\-ticket enterprise design pitches.
* **Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff:** Rigorously check and vet 100% of technical drawings (GFCs, MEP, civil, ceiling, layout) to ensure project execution teams receive flawless packages requiring zero back\-and\-forth clarification.
* **Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance:** Direct the in\-house BOQ and proposal team to ensure all creative concepts strictly adhere to targeted client budgets and Divine Innovation’s gross margin requirements.
* **Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership:** Oversee the internal furniture design team to produce precise, production\-ready factory shop drawings for custom joinery and workstations manufactured at the IMT Manesar plant.

**Tasks and Activities**

**1\. Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching**

* Take comprehensive project downloads from the Sales team, converting client headcount, aesthetic, and functional requirements into world\-class design solutions.
* Direct and mentor the studio team (interior designers, 3D renderers, space planners) to deliver designs that exceed client expectations ("happily flabbergast" the client).
* Partner with Sales Managers on key enterprise accounts to lead design presentations, walk CXOs through 3D models, and articulate design rationale.
* Enforce strict adherence to Divine Innovation's Process System Structure (PSS) for design SLA turnaround times from sales download to proposal delivery.

**2\. Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff**

* Personally review, mark up, and approve 100% of drawing packages generated by the studio prior to client sign\-off and site release.
* Deliver complete, hyper\-detailed Good for Construction (GFC) drawing dockets to the Head of Projects, eliminating any need for execution teams to seek mid\-project clarifications.
* Write crystal\-clear material specifications, bill\-of\-materials (BOM), and procurement notes so non\-technical Purchase team members can source exact items effortlessly.

**3\. Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance**

* Supervise proposal and BOQ estimators to build detailed cost breakdowns alongside design development.
* Enforce "Design\-to\-Budget" principles: either design strictly within an established client budget or establish a baseline BOQ that protects target gross margins.
* Review all pre\-bid BOQs and techno\-commercial proposals for line\-item accuracy, material specification alignment, and commercial safety before client submission.

**4\. Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership**

* Lead the dedicated Furniture Design team in developing custom modular workstations, executive desks, and loose furniture concepts.
* Ensure creation of millimeter\-accurate factory shop drawings (joinery details, hardware specs, finish schedules) for seamless production at the IMT Manesar manufacturing plant.
* Coordinate with the IMT Manesar production team to verify prototype feasibility, material availability, and manufacturing standards.

**Measurement Metrics**

* **Zero\-Query Handoff Rate:** 100% zero\-query technical handovers (Project execution team proceeds without requiring drawing clarifications).
* **Design SLA Adherence:** 100% compliance with internal PSS turnaround timelines from sales download to initial proposal presentation.
* **Design\-to\-Budget Accuracy:** 100% budget compliance with zero margin degradation caused by design oversights or unbudgeted material specs.
* **Enterprise Pitch Win Rate:** Contribution to achieving a 30%\+ win rate on key enterprise pitch presentations.
* **Non\-Technical Purchase Execution:** 0 purchasing errors resulting from vague or incomplete design specifications.

**Competencies We Are Looking For**

**Skills**

* Creative Design Leadership \& Commercial Workspace Concept Design
* High\-Impact Enterprise Client Pitching \& CXO Presentation
* Rigorous Technical Drawing Verification \& Detail Auditing (CAD/Revit/BIM)
* Design\-to\-Budget Engineering \& BOQ Estimation Governance
* Factory Shop Drawing Review (Modular Joinery \& Furniture Manufacturing)
* Cross\-Functional Specification Writing for Procurement Teams

**Knowledge**

* Deep expertise in commercial workplace architecture, space planning ratios, and ergonomics
* Thorough understanding of civil, MEP, HVAC, acoustic, lighting, and fire safety systems
* Material costs, finishing techniques, and commercial fit\-out procurement workflows
* Industrial furniture manufacturing processes, wood/metal joinery, and production workflows (IMT Manesar setup)

**Self\-Image**

* Master Design \& Technical Authority
* Creative Visionary with Commercial Discipline
* Flawless Execution Enabler

**Traits**

* Obsessive attention to technical detail and drawing accuracy
* High aesthetic sensibility combined with practical buildability
* Articulate, charismatic communicator with executive presence
* Calm under tight SLA pressure and multi\-project demands

**Motives**

* Driven by creating iconic, award\-worthy corporate workspace environments
* Motivated by technical perfection and zero\-error project execution
* Committed to building a seamless bridge between design creativity, manufacturing, and site delivery

title: Procurement Manager
description:
Procurement Manager – Industrial Automation

**Company:** Graven Automation Private Limited  
**Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Department:** Procurement  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 4–8 years  
**Salary:** ₹30,000–₹40,000/month \+ performance incentives *(depending on experience and capability)*

About Graven Automation

Graven Automation is a B2B industrial automation company dealing in PLCs, VFDs, HMIs, servo systems, control components, industrial electronics and automation spares from brands such as Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Allen\-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Delta, Yaskawa and others.

We are building a high\-speed, technology\-driven procurement operation where **ownership, response time and commercial intelligence** matter more than hierarchy.

Role Overview

We are looking for a **Procurement Manager** who can independently manage and improve the complete procurement function.

The person will be responsible for converting sales requirements into commercially viable purchase decisions by identifying suppliers, obtaining competitive pricing, negotiating, checking availability, managing purchase orders and coordinating timely dispatch.

**This is an ownership role — not just an RFQ\-follow\-up role.**

The ideal candidate should be able to look at a requirement and say:

“I have checked the options, these are the available sources, this is the landed cost, this is the expected delivery, and this is my recommendation.”Key Responsibilities1\. Procurement Management

* Manage complete procurement of industrial automation products and spares.
* Handle Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Allen\-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Delta, Yaskawa and other automation brands.
* Source products from authorized distributors, stockists, traders, importers and international suppliers.
* Maintain a strong supplier network across India and overseas.
* Identify alternative suppliers when regular sources cannot fulfil requirements.

2\. Price Negotiation

* Negotiate purchase prices, payment terms, delivery timelines and freight.
* Compare multiple supplier quotations before making purchasing decisions.
* Continuously identify cost\-saving opportunities.
* Maintain historical purchase\-price data and use it during negotiations.
* Understand market pricing and identify abnormal supplier quotations.

3\. Availability \& Lead Time

* Verify actual stock availability instead of relying only on verbal commitments.
* Confirm manufacturing/production dates, condition, warranty and delivery timelines where applicable.
* Track critical and urgent requirements.
* Develop alternate sourcing strategies for obsolete, discontinued or difficult\-to\-source products.

4\. Purchase Orders

* Review procurement requirements received from Sales/CCT.
* Select the appropriate supplier based on price, availability, reliability and delivery.
* Approve/recommend purchases according to company authority limits.
* Ensure purchase orders are accurate and commercially complete.
* Coordinate with Accounts and Dispatch for payment and delivery.

5\. Supplier Management

* Develop and maintain supplier relationships.
* Evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, availability, response time and reliability.
* Onboard new suppliers.
* Maintain supplier performance records.
* Negotiate improved commercial terms with high\-volume suppliers.
* Build backup suppliers for critical products and brands.

6\. Team Management

* Lead and manage the procurement team.
* Allocate procurement requirements among executives.
* Monitor procurement TAT and pending requirements.
* Train team members on sourcing, negotiation and supplier evaluation.
* Review team performance daily/weekly.
* Ensure no procurement requirement remains without an owner or next action.

7\. Cross\-Department Coordination

Work closely with:

**Sales → CCT → Procurement → Accounts → Dispatch**

Ensure that procurement does not become a bottleneck for sales orders.

8\. CRM / GravenOneDesk

* Maintain 100% procurement activity in GravenOneDesk.
* Ensure every requirement has a clear owner, status, next action and expected completion time.
* Maintain supplier quotations, purchase prices and procurement history.
* Monitor ageing and SLA breaches.
* Use procurement data to identify pricing trends, suppliers and savings opportunities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)KPIWeightProcurement TAT25%Purchase Price / Cost Savings20%Product Availability \& Lead Time15%Supplier Response \& Reliability10%New Supplier Development10%PO Accuracy10%Dispatch Coordination5%CRM Discipline5%Expected Performance

* Standard procurement requirement: **initial response within 30 minutes**
* Standard sourcing: **target completion within 2 hours**
* Urgent requirements: **priority handling immediately**
* Zero unattended procurement requirements.
* Every pending requirement must have a documented reason and next action.
* Escalation should happen **with a recommendation**, not simply with the problem.

What We Are Looking ForMust Have

* 4–8 years of procurement/purchasing experience.
* Experience with industrial automation/electrical/electronics/MRO products.
* Strong vendor network and sourcing capability.
* Excellent negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of PLC, VFD, HMI, servo, control components and industrial electrical products.
* Strong Excel/ERP/CRM skills.
* Ability to work under strict TATs.
* Strong communication and commercial judgement.

Preferred

* Experience with Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Allen\-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Delta, Yaskawa or similar brands.
* Experience in import/domestic sourcing.
* Experience dealing with distributors, stockists and system integrators.
* Experience managing a procurement team.
* Experience in B2B industrial distribution.

Most Important: Ownership

We are **not looking for someone who waits for instructions for every decision.**

We want someone who:

* Finds solutions before escalating.
* Negotiates instead of simply forwarding supplier prices.
* Finds alternate suppliers when the first supplier fails.
* Takes responsibility for delivery commitments.
* Tracks pending requirements without being reminded.
* Makes recommendations backed by data.
* Accepts mistakes and fixes them quickly.
* Understands that **procurement directly affects sales, margin and customer satisfaction.**

Our principle:

**Escalate the problem. Never escalate the ownership.**

Why Join Graven Automation?

* Fast\-growing industrial automation business.
* Technology\-driven procurement environment.
* GravenOneDesk CRM/ERP for real\-time operations.
* Opportunity to build and lead a professional procurement function.
* Performance\-based growth and incentives.
* Direct exposure to high\-value B2B industrial transactions.
* Opportunity to grow into **Head of Procurement / Procurement Operations Head** based on performance.

Selection Process

**Round 1:** HR / Initial Screening  
**Round 2:** Procurement \& Technical Assessment  
**Round 3:** Commercial Negotiation Case Study  
**Round 4:** Management Interview

Candidates will be evaluated on:

**Knowledge \+ Negotiation \+ Speed \+ Problem Solving \+ Ownership**

Only candidates who demonstrate the ability to **independently own procurement outcomes** will be selected.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Admin Head
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – ADMIN EXECUTIVE

**Company:** Right Gold  
**Department:** Administration \& Operations  
**Designation:** Admin Executive  
**Reporting To:** Management / Admin Head  
**Working Days:** 6 Days

**Timings:** 10:30 to 7:30pm

JOB PURPOSE

The Admin Executive will be responsible for **overall administrative coordination and monitoring of Accounts, Purchase, Marketing and Sales departments**. The role will ensure that all departments are following their daily processes, completing assigned tasks on time, maintaining proper records, and providing timely updates to Management.

The Admin Executive will act as a **central coordination point between departments and Management** to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Department Coordination \& Monitoring

* Coordinate with **Accounts, Purchase, Marketing and Sales departments** on their daily operational requirements.
* Take regular updates from respective department heads/team members regarding pending and completed work.
* Maintain a daily task and follow\-up tracker for all departments.
* Ensure assigned tasks are completed within the given timelines.
* Follow up on pending work and escalate delays to Management.
* Coordinate between departments whenever one department's work depends on another department.

2\. Accounts Department – Administrative Coordination

* Take regular updates from the Accounts team regarding pending and completed tasks.
* Follow up on pending bills, payments, collections, reconciliations and other assigned activities.
* Coordinate with Accounts for documents and information required by other departments.
* Maintain a record of important pending Accounts\-related matters.
* Escalate major delays or unresolved issues to Management.

**Note:** The Admin Executive will coordinate and monitor Accounts activities but will not be responsible for accounting entries, taxation, GST, finalisation or other technical accounting work.

3\. Purchase Department – Administrative Coordination

* Coordinate with the Purchase team regarding daily purchase requirements and pending orders.
* Follow up on quotations, purchase orders, deliveries and pending supplies.
* Monitor the status of outstanding purchase requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors and the Purchase team for timely delivery.
* Maintain a purchase follow\-up tracker.
* Escalate delayed or critical purchase requirements to Management.

4\. Marketing Department – Administrative Coordination

* Take regular updates from the Marketing team regarding ongoing campaigns, activities and assigned tasks.
* Monitor timelines for marketing activities and deliverables.
* Coordinate with Marketing regarding showroom requirements, promotional activities, events and campaigns.
* Follow up on pending marketing work and approvals.
* Maintain a marketing activity/task tracker.
* Coordinate between Marketing and Sales for campaign\-related requirements.

**Note:** The Admin Executive will monitor and coordinate Marketing activities but will not be responsible for creative strategy, content creation or campaign execution unless specifically assigned.

5\. Sales Department – Administrative Coordination

* Coordinate with the Sales team and Management regarding daily showroom operations.
* Monitor daily sales\-related reports and updates as required by Management.
* Follow up on pending customer\-related operational matters.
* Coordinate with Sales, Accounts and other departments for smooth order/payment/documentation processes.
* Monitor departmental requirements and escalate operational issues.
* Ensure important instructions from Management are communicated and followed up with the Sales team.

6\. Daily Reporting \& Follow\-up

* Prepare and maintain a **Daily Departmental Update Report**.
* Collect updates from Accounts, Purchase, Marketing and Sales.
* Maintain records of completed, pending and delayed tasks.
* Track responsible persons and expected completion dates.
* Submit consolidated updates to Management.
* Ensure no important task remains unattended or without follow\-up.

7\. Inter\-Department Coordination

* Coordinate between Accounts, Purchase, Marketing and Sales to avoid communication gaps.
* Ensure required information and documents are shared between departments on time.
* Resolve routine administrative coordination issues.
* Escalate matters requiring Management intervention.

8\. Discipline \& Process Monitoring

* Monitor adherence to company administrative procedures and Management instructions.
* Follow up on reporting, documentation and departmental processes.
* Identify recurring operational issues and report them to Management.
* Ensure departmental staff respond to official requirements and deadlines on time.

9\. Management Support

* Act as a coordination point between Management and the concerned departments.
* Communicate Management instructions to respective departments.
* Take follow\-up until assigned tasks are completed.
* Prepare consolidated reports whenever required by Management.
* Handle additional administrative and operational responsibilities assigned by Management.

REQUIRED SKILLS

* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets and MS Office**.
* Strong reporting and documentation skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments.
* Good problem\-solving and time\-management skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work under deadlines.

QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE

* Graduate in any discipline.
* **Minimum 3 years of relevant experience** in Administration, Operations, MIS, Coordination or a similar role.
* Experience in **retail/showroom operations** will be preferred.

KEY RESULT AREAS (KRA)

* Timely completion and follow\-up of departmental tasks.
* Effective coordination between Accounts, Purchase, Marketing and Sales.
* Daily and timely departmental reporting.
* Reduction of pending and delayed tasks.
* Proper communication and follow\-up of Management instructions.
* Maintenance of accurate trackers and records.
* Smooth coordination of day\-to\-day business operations.

IMPORTANT

The Admin Executive will have **administrative coordination and monitoring responsibility**, while the respective Department Heads/Managers will remain responsible for the technical and functional work of their departments.

The employee may be assigned **additional administrative, coordination and operational responsibilities by Management from time to time.**

Job Description

Guest Relations \& Sales Executive \- Lifeyoga

**Location:** New Delhi

**Function:** Guest Relations \& Sales

**Reporting To:** Centre / Guest Relations Lead

About Lifeyoga

Lifeyoga is a premium yoga and wellness destination focused on creating meaningful, personalised and transformative wellness experiences. The centre brings together yoga, movement, recovery and holistic wellbeing through thoughtfully designed programmes and an elevated guest experience.

The Role

We are looking for a **Guest Relations \& Sales Executive** who can own the guest journey from the moment a prospect walks into the centre through to conversion, membership, renewal and upsell.

This is **not a traditional front\-desk role**. The person will be expected to combine the warmth and attentiveness of a concierge with the commercial ownership of a sales professional.

The core objective is simple: **understand the guest, recommend the right Lifeyoga experience, and convert that need into a meaningful membership relationship.**

Key Responsibilities*1\. Guest Experience \& Concierge*

* Be the primary point of contact for guests and members at the centre.
* Create a warm, premium and personalised experience at every interaction.
* Understand each guest’s wellness objectives, preferences, schedule and barriers.
* Guide guests through classes, programmes, memberships and centre offerings.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance the guest experience.

*2\. Sales \& Conversion*

* Own sales conversations with walk\-ins, trial guests, introductory\-class attendees and other prospects.
* Convert trials and introductory experiences into memberships and subscriptions.
* Adopt a **consultative selling approach** rather than transactional selling.
* Match the guest’s needs and objectives to the most relevant Lifeyoga programme or membership.
* Clearly articulate the value, benefits and experience associated with each offering.
* Follow up with prospects who have not converted and actively move them through the sales funnel.
* Maintain strong conversion discipline across enquiries, trials, introductory classes and events.

*3\. Upselling \& Cross\-Selling*

* Identify opportunities to upgrade members to higher\-value or longer\-duration memberships.
* Encourage relevant add\-ons such as workshops, special sessions, private sessions and other Lifeyoga offerings.
* Identify changes in member behaviour or needs that create an opportunity for an upgrade or additional service.
* Drive **membership value and relationship depth**, not just transaction volume.

*4\. Renewal \& Retention*

* Build ongoing relationships with members beyond the initial sale.
* Track upcoming renewals and proactively engage members before expiry.
* Understand reasons for drop\-off, inactivity or non\-renewal and attempt recovery where appropriate.
* Work with the Guest Relations team to improve retention and lifetime value.
* Use member interactions as an opportunity to strengthen loyalty and engagement.

*5\. Lead \& Pipeline Management*

* Maintain accurate lead and prospect information in the CRM.
* Ensure every enquiry, trial and prospect has a clear next action.
* Follow up systematically through calls, WhatsApp and other approved channels.
* Track lead status, follow\-ups, conversions, lost opportunities and reasons for non\-conversion.
* Ensure no qualified lead is left unattended or without a defined next step.

*6\. Centre \& Team Collaboration*

* Coordinate closely with teachers, Guest Relations, Centre Operations teams.
